decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already captures the $30 split, increases the founder share to $12, retains $10 for the affiliate and $8 for the prize pool, and narrows the prize-pool destination to Small Block.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows Chainlink VRF selection from Small and Big Block draws to the continuing Small Block draw.
The existing message-195 MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket lifecycle and narrows the scope contexts to Small Block ticket behavior.
The existing message-195 MODIFY removes the obsolete Big Block ticket allocation while preserving the four Small Block tickets per coded referral mint.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the automatic wallet-transfer payout mode for the continuing $900 prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter from NFT metadata while preserving the Small Block counter and badges.

The approved FAQ still describes Big Block prizes, Big Block tickets, $6,000 draws, and the former $8 founder share; those statements necessarily become stale when Big Blocks are removed and the purchase split changes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marcus, please remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $8 to me. The new breakdown should be:
$30 purchase, $12 to me, $10 to the affiliate, and $8 to the block prize pool.

That should improve my bottom line without materially affecting sales, while also making the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even arrangement between me and each community member, together with an equal opportunity to win the continuing $900 prizes, feels consistent with the project's ethos.
